method.method_draft: Compute I as I_U + I_S_contrib. With only U_S active, open the current source; the right-top resistor carries no current, and the center node is a divider between U_S through one R and ground through the vertical R, so V_C = U_S/2 = 3 V and the downward middle current contribution is 3/6 = 0.5 A. With only I_S active, short the voltage source; the center node is connected to ground through the left R and vertical R, and the current source forces 2 A through the top-right resistor path. Use KCL at the center node to get V_C/R + V_C/R + I_S = 0, so V_C = -6 V and the middle current contribution is -6/6 = -1 A. Add the contributions: I = 0.5 A - 1 A = -0.5 A.
